system.description:
At the start of a scene, you gain [Cancel (Blight): 20]. [Self: Hidden]: When you participate in an opposed check as the aggressor, the defender takes a -1D penalty.

A costume woven from a special material that does not reflect light. The wearer's appearance melts into the darkness, making it difficult to see.

Dusk Wings [Core Material] (30G) + Martial Arts Dress (120G) + [Magic Catalyst 2] (20G) x 3 + Crafting Cost (110G)
